---
title: "Time series and observed vs. predicted - Aalborg Vest-LT1"
author: "KSA"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d')`"
output: md_document
params:
  results_dir: "results/Aalborg Vest-LT1"
  cluster_type: "graph"
  # prediction window (number of samples ahead) to show, one of 1, 5, 10, 15, 20
  predwindow: 10
  # regex matched against the OTU column
  OTU_regex: "^FLASV3\\.1527;|^FLASV9592\\.1533;|^FLASV4\\.1481;"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  error = FALSE,
  fig.width = 12,
  fig.height = 5,
  cache = FALSE
)

# when knitting the working directory is always the folder of the Rmd file
if (interactive() && !grepl("analysis$", getwd())) {
  setwd("analysis")
}

library("ampvis2")
library("data.table")
library("patchwork")
library("lubridate")
library("tune")

source("functions.R")
set.seed(42)
```

Real and predicted relative abundance over time (left), and real vs. predicted abundance (right) for selected ASVs in `r basename(params$results_dir)`, predicting `r params$predwindow` samples ahead. The vertical line marks the start of the test period. Plots are also saved as PNG files in the `figures` subfolder of the results.

```{r load}
long <- amp_export_long(
  combine_abund(params$results_dir, params$cluster_type, params$predwindow)
)
OTUs <- unique(long[grepl(params$OTU_regex, OTU), OTU])
```

```{r plots, results="asis"}
for (otu in OTUs) {
  plot <- plot_ts_obs_pred(long[OTU == otu])

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      params$results_dir,
      "figures",
      paste0(sub(";.*$", "", otu), "_predwindow", params$predwindow, ".png")
    ),
    plot = plot,
    width = 12,
    height = 5
  )

  cat("\n\n# ", otu_label(otu), "\n\n", sep = "")
  print(plot)
}
```
